subject: VitaHealth renewal: coordinate QBR + condensed roadmap demo windows
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@vitahealth.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@vitahealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-10T18:02:00-04:00
Subject: VitaHealth renewal: coordinate QBR + condensed roadmap demo windows

Hi Samantha / Tom —

As we approach your renewal, I want to propose a compact Renewal QBR + roadmap demo focused on the two things everyone cares about: the operational improvements (latency/cost wins from recent configs) and the product roadmap that impacts your integration. The goal is a 60-minute working session with clear next steps and a follow-up packet (pricing/AM action items).

Two options I can make work (all in EDT):
  • Wed Aug 2 — 13:00–14:00 EDT (recommended; exec-friendly)
  • Thu Aug 3 — 15:00–16:00 EDT (backup; our product lead will join)

Please let me know: (1) which slot is best, (2) who on your side needs to attend (procurement, engineering, exec), and (3) any agenda items to prioritize. I attached a short proposed-agenda and the QBR template we typically use.

If helpful, we can split the session (30m exec + 30m technical breakout) but looking to keep it lean.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: proposed-agenda.pdf

Subject: Re: VitaHealth renewal: coordinate QBR + condensed roadmap demo windows

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the heads up. Wed Aug 2 at 13:00 EDT works better for the leadership team here. A couple notes from our side:

  • Please make this a condensed QBR — leadership prefers 45–60 minutes max.
  • Keep the demo focused on roadmap items that materially affect cost/latency or the SSO/data residency controls we highlighted last quarter.
  • Procurement (cc'd) will need the renewal estimate ahead of the meeting.

Attendees on our side likely: me (Head of Product), Tom Hale (Engineering lead), and Maria Clarke from Procurement (procurement@vitahealth.com). If you need more time with engineering we can schedule a follow-up technical deep-dive.

Samantha Ortiz
Head of Product, VitaHealth

Great — thanks for the quick reply, Samantha. Wed Aug 2 at 13:00 EDT is penciled on my side. Per your ask, we'll keep it to ~50 minutes: 20m exec summary (value delivered + pricing signal), 25m roadmap demo (monica will walk through items that touch data residency and cost), 5m next steps and action owners.

I've attached a preliminary renewal estimate (vita-renewal-estimate.xlsx) for procurement to review ahead of time. Naomi (cc'd) will own the pricing walk and will send a cleaned DocuSign link once we lock the slot.

If for any reason leadership can't make the real-time slot, we'll record and provide the short highlights + an AM-specific action tracker.

Proposed attendees from our side:
  • Naomi Feldman — Account Executive (will lead pricing)
  • Monica Patel — Product (roadmap + feature impact)
  • Rishi Malhotra — Sponsor/AM (exec summary + next steps)

Could Procurement confirm they received the estimate? Also, Samantha, would you like the 30m technical follow-up to be scheduled right after (same week) or kept separate?

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Samantha — Naomi here, thanks for confirming Aug 2. I'll host the pricing segment and Monica will lead the roadmap portion.

Action items before the meeting:
  1) Procurement: confirm receipt of the estimate and flag any immediate questions (procurement@vitahealth.com).
  2) VitaHealth engineering: please send any blockers or integration questions you'd like Monica to address in the 25m slot (Tom, feel free to drop bullet points).
  3) Rishi/Naomi: we'll upload the final DocuSign link to the HubSpot deal record and share to this thread 48 hours before the meeting.

For planning — if the execs want a shorter session, we can compress the demo to 15m and move technical details into a separate 30m follow-up early next week. Otherwise, we'll stick to the 50m plan.

Naomi Feldman
